g.text: Conditioning selects backgrounds; intervention keeps them
U_Z and U_X are independent binary noises; U_Y=0.
Natural: X=Z+U_X and Y=X+Z. Conditioning X=2 retains only (Z,U_X)=(1,1).
Under do(X=2), all four backgrounds retain probability 0.25.
